diagnostic_ir_schema_version.description: Optional A.13 hard-register schema marker. Omit for current schema-light Diagnostic IR behavior.

registers.description: A.13 hard-register object. It is valid only with diagnostic_ir_schema_version = 0.4.3-hard-registers-v1 and is not required by schema-light runtime output.

diagnostic_target.description: Object being diagnosed. Concealment mode attaches here by default, not to the requester.

concealment_applies_to.description: Scope of the concealment-mode diagnosis. Use requester only when requester self-state is explicitly the target.

requester_posture.description: Visible posture of the person asking, when relevant. This is contextual and not a hidden-state diagnosis unless self-state is the target.

clarification_pressure.description: Optional adjacent pressure for sincere shubhah, shakk/rayb, tawahhum, or doubt-pressure cases where no refusal-mode concealment is operative but clarity remains covered.

gate_trigger.description: Identifies which of the six dispatch gate checks fired and blocked module activation. Format: 'check [1-6] — [rule id or stop id]', e.g. 'check 3 — S-2' or 'check 4 — Stop-2'. Omit when routing_gate is 'open'.

reconstruction_fidelity.description: Reconstruction verdict from original input plus populated IR/trace candidate. Optional for legacy artifacts; required by the reconstruction pass before ordinary dispatch.

reconstructor_notes.description: Brief note naming what could not be recovered when reconstruction_fidelity is partial/fail, or compact neighbor contrast when present on pass.

structural_pattern_print.description: Optional compact local description of the active structural pattern when PF code alone is too coarse to preserve practical framing. It is subordinate to claim_level, pattern_profile, and routing precedence.

load_bearing_node.description: Optional criterion, authority rule, semantic hinge, category-set, or noetic blocker currently carrying the pressure.

collapse_radius.description: Optional downstream claims, routes, or held content whose status depends on clearing the load-bearing node.

intervention_target.description: Optional bounded operation that clears the load-bearing node before downstream content can release.

framing_notes.description: Optional internal renderer constraint that prevents argument-bank, citation-dump, or wrong-family release behavior. Not public boilerplate.

decisive_missing_differentiator.description: Conditional-mandatory when confidence is not strong or read_status is not dominant; names the signal that would refine, falsify, or collapse the remaining ambiguity.

source_basis.$comment: source_basis is schema-optional for bare schema compatibility, but checker-mandatory whenever matched_modules is present. The executable enforcement lives in tools/check_ir_instance_integrity.py.

owner_activation_ordering.$comment: Pre-Layer-B deterministic owner selection plan. It governs matched owner route order, ACT order, and field_witness owner activation roles; it is not a proof ledger by itself.

field_witness.$comment: Optional schema-light trace sidecar. It is validated when present, does not replace post_render_gate, and does not imply full formal-calculus proof, truth, warrant, or interlocutor uptake.

reread_pressure.$comment: Optional TTP-MRP evidence. It records how the post-landed reread state was pressured before STOP/HOLD/RECURSE/LoopBreak/closure.

route_gradient.description: Plain-∇ directional reread after Land(ⁿB): held target, generated target, HOLD, LoopBreak, or STOP.

normalized_activation_record.$comment: Schema-light reproducibility record. It is derived from owner_activations, MRP resultants, terminal states, and generated-burden depth; it is not proof by itself.

per_burden.$comment: Historical field name. Rows are ACT/owner-activation level: one row per visible ACT / owner_activations[] object. Multiple rows may share a burden_id when several owners land one burden.

delta_result.$comment: Suffix token only. For owner families listed in delta-result-vocabulary.json, check_ir_instance_integrity.py enforces membership in that owner-local vocabulary.

canonical_ir_projection.$comment: Optional A.13.3.1 machine-facing hard-register projection. It is version-gated, opt-in, not public prose, not full IR decode, and not interlocutor uptake proof.

register_composition.$comment: Optional B.5/register-composition evidence. Dedicated semantic checks remain owned by check_nla_decode_semantic_faithfulness.py.

decoded_ir.$comment: Optional B.5.2 decode object. It is a checker-owned IR-like reconstruction from visible ACT plus field_witness/NAR/projection evidence; it is not arbitrary natural-language full IR decode.

full_ir_decode.$comment: Optional B.5 full-IR decode scaffold. It reconciles decoded_ir with field_witness graph/terminal/generated-burden/formal-reread state where present. Dedicated semantic checks remain owned by check_nla_decode_semantic_faithfulness.py.

coverage_proof.$comment: Schema-light collapse reconstruction for field_witness. Coverage proves rendered accounting, not live noetic competence.

diagnostic_completeness.$comment: Optional A.13 hard-register reconciliation witness. Required by check_ir_instance_integrity.py when hard-register v1 IR is paired with field_witness.

post_render_gate.description: Mandatory post-render state re-read / re-entry gate. It must run after every bounded restorative move and before any STOP decision.
